$comment: Overrides for `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. This file is to motion what `semantic.dark.json` is to the theme: a separate set of values the build emits in a conditional block. Motion reduction is therefore a declaration in the token source rather than a rule written out again in every stylesheet.

transition.$comment: Not `0s`: in some browsers a zero duration emits no `transitionend`, so code waiting for a transition to end stops receiving the event. `0.01ms` is visually instant and keeps the event.

loop.$comment: A continuous indicator slows down instead of disappearing — the user still sees that work is under way, but the spin stops being a vestibular trigger.
